surgery_adv_complex_abdominal_reconstruc.diagnosis: 随机返场病例：既往复杂腹部损伤及症状相关黏连，拟行限定范围的器官保留性修复。
surgery_adv_complex_abdominal_reconstruc.diagnosis_en: Repeat case: complex old abdominal injury with symptomatic adhesions requiring targeted organ-preserving repair.

surgery_adv_open_descending_thoracic_aor.diagnosis: 随机返场病例：胸段降主动脉瘤，拟行左开胸血管置换及必要灌注保护。本病例需重接重要肋间动脉分支。
surgery_adv_open_descending_thoracic_aor.diagnosis_en: Repeat case: descending thoracic aortic aneurysm requiring left thoracotomy, graft replacement and perfusion protection. This case requires reattachment of critical intercostal artery branches.

surgery_adv_posttraumatic_thoracolumbar_.diagnosis: 随机返场病例：陈旧胸腰椎压缩骨折后固定性后凸及矢状面失衡，拟行后路椎体切除重建与内固定融合。
surgery_adv_posttraumatic_thoracolumbar_.diagnosis_en: Repeat case: fixed kyphosis and sagittal imbalance after an old thoracolumbar compression fracture, planned for posterior vertebral column resection and instrumented fusion.
